briefing:
# NVIDIA Pre-Meeting Briefing: Meeting of 17 November 2026

*Prepared as of 15 November 2026. Coverage window: approximately 18 October to 17 November 2026.*

## Executive Summary

NVIDIA's chief executive, Jensen Huang, resigned with immediate effect, and CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO while keeping her CFO role ([Craske, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). The board also named Harvey C. Jones as its first chair ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)). The shares fell more than 12% in early trading after the announcement ([Howley, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/nvidia-ceo-huang-resigns-amid-affair-scandals-board-names-cfo-colette-kress-interim-ceo-135801377.html)). Third-quarter fiscal 2027 results are due on 17 November, the day of this meeting ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-sets-conference-call-for-third-quarter-financial-results-6928873)).

My assessment is that the most material issue for this meeting is governance and legal exposure, not demand. The sources show no weakness in reported fundamentals, and the company's own guidance and product messaging point to continuity. The open items are who leads the company, whether the investigations widen, and whether the interim structure holds through the earnings call.

## Scope and Method

Sources were ranked by reliability. Primary company disclosures (NVIDIA Newsroom) and wire-based or established news outlets carry the most weight. Algorithmic commentary, AI-generated summaries, and aggregator pages were used only where they corroborate primary sources or where they are flagged in the final section. Where sources conflict, both versions are reported.

## What Changed in the Last 30 Days

### Leadership and Governance

Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO and board member with immediate effect. The board accepted the resignation on 11 November, a day before the announcement ([Craske, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Mashable described it as the first CEO change in the company's 33-year history ([Mashable, n.d.](https://mashable.com/tech/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo)). Huang co-founded NVIDIA in 1993 ([Craske, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)).

Kress will serve as interim CEO until a permanent successor is named ([Quantisnow, n.d.](https://quantisnow.com/insight/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition-6786728)). The board is considering both internal and external candidates ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). Al Jazeera, citing Reuters, lists Ian Buck and Rene Haas as names under discussion. These are industry speculation, not confirmed candidates ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)).

The board said it has "full confidence" in Kress and the leadership team and expects "operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption" ([Craske, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in)). Separately, NVIDIA's newsroom lists statements from the board on 8 November and from independent board members on 10 November ([NVIDIA Newsroom, 2026](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-ceo-transition)). I could not review the content of these statements, so they are flagged in the verification table.

### Regulatory and Legal News

Reports linked the resignation to allegations about Huang's personal relationships ([Al Jazeera, 2026](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/12/why-did-nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resign-and-who-is-colette-kress)). The Justice Department has not determined whether the woman in question is a Chinese spy. It is also investigating, with the Commerce Department, whether a Singaporean company bought advanced NVIDIA chips to send to China ([CNN, 2026](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/11/business/live-news/nvidia-jensen-huang-investigation-fallout)).

House Foreign Affairs Committee Chairman Brian Mast said he was prepared to subpoena Huang unless he responded by 11 November to a request for a closed-door briefing. No subpoena had been issued at the time of reporting ([Lanz, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-erases-2026-gains-republicans-threaten-jensen-huang-with-subpoena.html)). The CNN headline describes Huang as "summoned to testify," which goes further than the reporting I could verify. This conflict is flagged below.

### Market Performance

|---|---|---|
| 9 Oct 2026 | Close of $229.28, the start of the 30-day reference period | [Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |
| 6 Oct 2026 | Record closing high of $239.24 | [Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |
| 5 Nov 2026 | Fell 9.26% to $181.60, erasing roughly $450 billion in market value, after the U.S. midterm elections | [Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |
| 6 Nov 2026 | Close of $186.64, the fifth consecutive weekly loss | [Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |
| 10 Nov 2026 | Shares fell to $166.95, down 18.42% for November and erasing 2026 gains | [Lanz, 2026](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-erases-2026-gains-republicans-threaten-jensen-huang-with-subpoena.html) |
| 12 Nov 2026 | Shares fell more than 13% in early trading after the CEO news | [Craske, 2026](https://datacentremagazine.com/news/nvidia-ceo-jensen-huang-resigns-as-colette-kress-steps-in) |
| 13 Nov 2026 | Close of $162.85, down 2.01% on the day, market capitalisation $4.51 trillion | [Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753) |

My calculation from these figures: the 13 November close is about 32% below the record closing high. Sector pressure is also visible. AMD fell 5.03% on a broad semiconductor pullback with no company-specific news ([Evans, 2026](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-slides-18-6-over-30-days-what-the-sell-off-means-for-investors-32753)). Intel fell about 41% over 30 days after weak guidance
